# Keys

<!-- Generated by `go generate .` from the code. Do not edit by hand. -->

These are the keys of the terminal interface, which `lazyaria` opens when
you run it with no command. `?` shows the same list on screen. Keys
in a dialog are listed in [The terminal interface](../guides/terminal-interface.md).

| Keys | What they do |
|---|---|
| `j` `down` | move down |
| `k` `up` | move up |
| `g` `home` | go to the first download |
| `G` `end` | go to the last download |
| `pgup` `ctrl+u` | move a page up |
| `pgdown` `ctrl+d` | move a page down |
| `1` | show what is downloading |
| `2` | show what is waiting |
| `3` | show finished downloads |
| `4` | show problems, when there are any |
| `]` `tab` | next tab |
| `[` `shift+tab` | previous tab |
| `enter` | open or close details on a narrow terminal |
| `J` | scroll details down |
| `K` | scroll details up |
| `a` | add a download |
| `space` | pause or resume |
| `x` `delete` | remove from the list |
| `u` | undo a remove while its note shows |
| `?` | show or hide these keys |
| `q` `ctrl+c` | quit; downloads keep going |
